title: Local Business Lead Pipeline Input
description: Two ways to scope a run. Easy mode: pass cities and categories and the pipeline cross-joins them into Google Maps queries. Power mode: pass raw search queries. Each returned place is enriched with website verification, DNS MX, and email patterns, then scored as basic or enriched.

cities.title: Cities
cities.description: Cities or locations to search. Examples: ["Austin TX", "Brooklyn NY", "Manchester UK"]. Combined with categories to form one query per pair.
cities.sectionDescription: Use either this block or the raw queries below. If both are set, both run.

searchQueries.title: Raw search queries
searchQueries.description: Optional. Pre-built Google Maps queries. Examples: "dentist 78704", "plumbers near Miami".

maxPlacesPerQuery.title: Max places per query
maxPlacesPerQuery.description: Cap on Google Maps results pulled per query. Higher values find more leads but cost more time.

maxPlacesTotal.title: Max places per run
maxPlacesTotal.description: Hard cap on places processed per run. Controls total cost.

minRating.title: Minimum rating (enriched tier)
minRating.description: Places below this rating are still returned as basic leads, but cannot qualify as enriched. Default 4.0 filters out neglected listings.

minReviews.title: Minimum review count (enriched tier)
minReviews.description: Places below this review count are still returned as basic leads, but cannot qualify as enriched. Default 10 filters out fake or new listings.

requireWebsite.title: Require a working website for enriched tier
requireWebsite.description: Enriched leads must have a website that resolves and has a valid MX record. Recommended on for outbound use cases.

scrapeReviewsForSentiment.title: Pull recent reviews for sentiment
scrapeReviewsForSentiment.description: Asks the Maps scraper for up to 5 recent reviews per place to surface negative review count. Adds time per place.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: Apify proxy passed through to the Google Maps stage. Residential strongly recommended.
